question: By whose grace is the speaker able to come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching?
premises: Knowledge of the Kaula determination is not self-originated by the speaker.
The speaker addresses the Lord of the Kaulas directly.
That knowledge is attributed to the grace of the one addressed.
inference: By the grace of the Lord of the Kaulas, the speaker has come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
uncertainties: The mode by which grace produces knowledge is not specified here.
plain_english: By your grace, O Lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
